$schema_comment: Aligned with docs/orchestrator/capability-flow-contract.md §4 and runtime-permission domains. Positive allow-list per role; used for plan-time validation and runtime role/domain precheck before the permission evaluator.

orchestrator.notes: Plan/decide default Ollama (local_model + network); MCP bridge; remote_model when Claude transport is used for plan/decide; git for orchestrator-owned worktree lifecycle only (classified shell); no arbitrary workspace shell.

owner.notes: Scope and acceptance; Claude session read/query.

architect.notes: Design and diagrams; no implementation apply.

dev-frontend.notes: Same capability envelope as dev-backend unless policy narrows later.

qa.notes: Read artifacts and review; local_model + network when local-only routes QA through Ollama HTTP; remote_model for Claude path.

cerberus.notes: Read outputs for review; local_model + network when local-only routes CERBERUS through Ollama HTTP; credential ceiling remains read via permissions.js.
